findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "voice_agent" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: text, url, instructions, history, lang, voice

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "dialogue" appears informational but accepts parameters (script) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "voice" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: transcribe_summary · Private data: transcribe, subtitles_translate · Public sink: transcribe, transcribe_long, transcribe_summary, transcribe_speakers, dub, voice_agent · Destructive: transcribe_long, subtitles_translate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: transcribe_summary · Private data: transcribe, subtitles_translate · Public sink: transcribe, transcribe_long, transcribe_summary, transcribe_speakers, dub, voice_agent · Destructive: transcribe_long, subtitles_translate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "text_to_speech" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
